body: REVIEW HOLD on exact candidate 460a14a (bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF). The Chart change is locally correct: eligibility now asks the same structuralMembers population that ChartDistance.reduction measures, and the positive control is non-vacuous. But the same carrier still has the symmetric Structural defect, so this candidate cannot close the population as reported. structuralReduction also measures only view.structuralMembers(node.ref) charts, yet structuralEligible is merely providerConfigured && unit.evidence.nonEmpty. Exact-candidate external court: Anna segment sc2, unit chart present, every source structural member chartless; compare configured StructuralDistance.of((_,_) => 0.0) with StructuralDistance.missing. In both cases the Structural term is absent. Nevertheless configuration alone moves (supportWeight,total) from (0.9552238805970149,1.3704545454545454) to (0.8311688311688312,1.575). That invents an eligible measurement the cell cannot have and can bias chartless cells toward External. The repair should make Structural eligibility require a configured provider, unit evidence, AND at least one charted structural member, with a court that the configured provider is inert on a chartless cell plus a charted-member positive control. Also exact candidate emits E198 unused import CheckState.Checked at CostSuite.scala:261 in a clean clone; remove it. Disposition: HOLD as a completion candidate; ACCEPT the narrow Chart predicate if chief explicitly lands it as partial and keeps the bead open. Probe tree /private/tmp/storymodel-chart-review.E9ONF1/repo, test filter *configured*, 0/1 with the exact tuple diff above.
